title: Equivariant Borsuk-Ulam extensions to other group actions

problemStatement.plain: AVAILABLE: How do equivariant versions of Borsuk-Ulam extend to other group actions?.

currentState.focus: Gallery entry created. Survey of equivariant Borsuk-Ulam with proved infrastructure and axiomized deep results.

knowledge.progressSummary: SURVEYED: Gallery entry created. Framework proved (equivariant maps, composition, orbits). Z/2 case derived from classical Borsuk-Ulam. Z/p rotation isometry and freeness proved. Yang-Borsuk, Dold, and general free-G cases axiomized. Open: non-free actions, optimal bounds for compact Lie groups.

insights: The equivariant reformulation: odd f: Sⁿ → ℝⁿ is exactly Z/2-equivariant; the theorem says equivariant maps must vanish
For prime p, Z/p acts FREELY on S^(2n-1) via coordinate rotations by 2π/p; freeness key for Yang-Borsuk
Freeness of Z/p rotation proved elementarily: cos(2π/p) = 1 implies n·p = 1 impossible for prime p ≥ 2
Dold 1983 gives cohomological index obstruction generalizing both Z/2 and Z/p cases to arbitrary free finite G-actions
Non-free actions and compact Lie groups (SO(n), U(n)) are the main open frontier — requires equivariant K-theory and Smith theory

Smith theory for non-free group actions (prerequisite for non-free Borsuk-Ulam)
nextSteps: Dold theorem proof would require formalizing equivariant cohomological index — major but tractable long-term project (500-1000 lines)
